_readme: Hand-maintained factual corrections, applied over locations.json by src/data/enrich.js.
These live here rather than in locations.json because build-data.mjs REGENERATES that file
from the research markdown — direct edits there are lost on the next build.
Source: the FACT NOTES / 'data note for client' lines in research/book/batches/*.md.
Each key is a location id; each value is a shallow patch. Add the batch it came from.

wemyss-castle-mary-darnley.coordinate_note: Confirmed against Historic Environment Scotland listing LB16709 (Category A) and Canmore ID 53957. Private residence; walled gardens open on a limited basis only.

hampton-court-palace.coordinate_note: Major palace, precisely mapped. Historically in Middlesex; Surrey since the 1965 boundary changes.

gateways-club._from: batch-11, topic 54; connective-matter evidence audit, 25 August 2026
gateways-club.hook: Behind a green door at 239 King's Road, the Gateways became what English Heritage calls London's best-known and longest-lived lesbian social venue. It introduced a women-only policy in 1967, closed in September 1985, and received an English Heritage blue plaque on 2 July 2025.
